definitions.explanation: The state of being innocent of a crime or accusation; having not committed the alleged offense.

examples.japanese: {無実|むじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誓|ちか}って→誓う：00030_chikau⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無実|むじつ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I swear to God, I am innocent.

notes:
{無実|むじつ} combines ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (truth/substance), literally meaning "without substance" — i.e., the accusation has no basis in fact.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {無実|むじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: a false charge, being wrongly accused
- {無実|むじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}する→証明する：17851_shoumeisuru⟧: to prove one's innocence
- {無実|むじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧: to claim innocence
- {無実|むじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to appeal one's innocence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無実|むじつ}: innocent (factual — did not commit the crime)
- ⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧: not guilty (legal verdict in court)
- ⟦{冤罪|えんざい}→冤罪：08392_enzai⟧: false charge, wrongful conviction

REGISTER:
Used in legal, news, and literary contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦やっていない→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (didn't do it) is more natural.
